</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's check the probability of outcomes of Events A, B C and D step by step and draw out interpretation at end.

We will compare the possibilties to derive which statement fits which two given events. 

|   | Event                 | Favorable Outcome | Total Outcome   |  Probability    |
|---|-----------------------|-------------------|:---------------:|:---------------:|
| A | either a $5$ or a $6$ | $5$ and $6 = 2$   |       $6$       | $\dfrac {2}{6}$ |
| B | an even number        | $2, 3$ and $6 = 3$|       $6$       | $\dfrac {3}{6}$ |
| C | a prime number        | $2, 3$ and $5 = 3$|       $6$       | $\dfrac {3}{6}$ |
| D | a multiple of $3$     | $3$ and $6 = 2$   |       $6$       | $\dfrac {2}{6}$ |

Now lets **inspect** the statements.

Statement 1 : A $\text{\textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore}$ B.

$
\begin{aligned} 
    \text{A}             & : \text{B}             \\\\
    \dfrac {2}{6}        & : \dfrac {3}{6}        \\\\
    \text{P(A)} & < \text{P(B)} 
\end{aligned}
$

A $\underline {\text {is less likely to happen than}}$ B.

Statement 2 : B $\text{\textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore}$ C.

$
\begin{aligned} 
    \text{B}             & : \text{C}             \\\\
    \dfrac {3}{6}        & : \dfrac {3}{6}        \\\\
    \text{P(B)} & < \text{P(C)} 
\end{aligned}
$

B $\underline {\text {has the same chance of happening as}}$ C.

Statement 3 : C $\text{\textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore}$ D.

$
\begin{aligned} 
    \text{C}             & : \text{D}             \\\\
    \dfrac {3}{6}        & : \dfrac {2}{6}        \\\\
    \text{P(C)} & < \text{P(D)} 
\end{aligned}
$

C $\underline {\text {is more likely to happen than}}$ D.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

A $\underline {\text {is less likely to happen than}}$ B.

B $\underline {\text  {has the same chance of happening as}}$ C.

C $\underline {\text  {is more likely to happen than}}$ D.

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tristan is given six bags of fruit.

Bag $A$ contains $2$ apples, $4$ oranges and $3$ pears.

Bag $B$ contains $3$ apples, $1$ orange and $2$ pears. 

Bag $C$ contains $4$ apples, $5$ oranges and $3$ pears.

Bag $D$ contains $4$ apples, $6$ oranges and $4$ pears. 

Bag $E$ contains $6$ apples, $4$ oranges and $3$ pears.

Bag $F$ contains $7$ apples, $7$ oranges and $7$ pears.

He is allowed to choose one of these bags and then pick just one piece of fruit from that bag at random.

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which bag should he choose if he is to **maximise** his chance of picking an apple?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which bag should he choose if he is to **maximise** his chance of picking an apple?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{P(apple in bag A)} &= \dfrac {2} {9} \\\\ 
                        &= 0.22 \\\\
\text{P(apple in bag B)} &= \dfrac {3} {6} \\\\ 
                         &= \dfrac {3}{2 \times 3} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {\cancel {3}} {2 \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                         &= 0.50 \\\\
\text{P(apple in bag C)} &= \dfrac {4} {12} \\\\ 
                         &= \dfrac {4}{3 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {\cancel {4}} {3 \times \cancel{4}} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                         &= 0.33 \\\\
\text{P(apple in bag D)} &= \dfrac {4} {14} \\\\ 
                         &= \dfrac {2 \times 2}{7 \times 2} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel {2}} {7 \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
                         &= 0.28 \\\\
\text{P(apple in bag E)} &= \dfrac {6} {13} \\\\
                         &= 0.46 \\\\
\text{P(apple in bag F)} &= \dfrac {7} {21} \\\\ 
                         &= \dfrac {7}{3 \times 7} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {\cancel {7}} {3 \times \cancel{7}} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                         &= 0.33
\end{aligned}
$

Bag $B$ 
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Bag $B$ 

</div>
</div>

**Question**

John experiments by rolling a single dice and a spinner simultaneously. He rolls an ordinary dice with a possible score 
of $1, 2, 3, 4, 5$ or $6$. At the same time he also spins a spinner with a possible score of $0, 1, 2$ or $3$. 
His total score is worked out by **multiplying** the two individual scores together.

Complete the table below to show all $24$ equally likely final scores.

| Score     | $1$   | $2$   | $3$   | $4$   | $5$   | $6$   |
|:---:  |:---:  |:---:  |:---:  |:---:  |:---:  |:---:  |
| $0$   |   |   |   |   |   |   |
| $1$   |   |   | $3$   |   |   |   |
| $2$   |   |   |   |   |   | $12$  |
| $3$   |   |   |   | $12$  |   |   |

$

\text{P(0)} &= \dfrac {6} {24} \\\\ 
                        &= \dfrac {6} {4 \times 6} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {6}} {4 \times \cancel {6}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {4}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There is an even chance that I will pick a toffee from a large bag of sweets containing toffees, jellies and chocolates.  
If the bag contains $17$ jellies and $8$ chocolates, how many toffees are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There is an even chance that I will pick a toffee from a large bag of sweets containing toffees, jellies and chocolates.  
If the bag contains $17$ jellies and $8$ chocolates, how many toffees are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

It will be even chance to select a toffee or jellies and chocolates if the number of toffee is equal to number of jellies and chocolates.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of toffee}   &= 17 + 8 \\\\
                          &= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of toffee $= p$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {p} {25 + p}  &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
2 \times p           &= 25 + p \\\\
2p                   &= 25 + p \\\\
2p - p               &= 25 \\\\
p                    &= 25
\end{aligned}
$

Number of toffee $= 25$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$25$

</div>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Nina pulls one envelope from the lucky dip.
<emptyline>
What is the probability that she has won a prize?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{P(card E)}        &= \dfrac {1 + 1 + 1 + 1} {10} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {4} {10} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 2} {5 \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \cancel {2}} {5 \times \cancel {2}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2} {5}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {2} {5}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Arrange the letters for each of these events in order, starting with the least likely:

- Rolling a dice and getting a three
- Rolling two dice and getting a total of $15$
- The next person who walks in the door was born on a Wednesday
- The last digit of a telephone number is NOT a $9$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

- The last digit of a telephone number is NOT a $9$

\text{P(last digit of a telephone number is NOT a 9)} &= \dfrac {9} {10} \\\\

                              &= 0.25
\end{aligned}
$

Higher probability = Bag $\text{B}$
</div>

$4$ are red, $2$ are blue and the rest are green.

She picks a counter at random from the bag.

probability that the counter she picks is:

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-1/s01-q26-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-1/s01-q26-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-1/s01-q26-i00.png")

There are twice as many blue counters as red counters in the bag.


She picks one counter at random from the bag.

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-1/s01-q26-i01.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-1/s01-q26-i01.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-1/s01-q26-i01.png")

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of green counters}     &= \dfrac{24}{2} &= 12 \\\\
\text{P(green)} &= \dfrac {12} {24} \\\\ 
                        &= \dfrac {12} {2 \times 12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {2}} {2 \times \cancel {12}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which is more likely, rolling a $3$ with an unbiased die with six faces, or getting a head with a fair coin?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which is more likely, rolling a $3$ with an unbiased die with six faces, or getting a head with a fair coin?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{P(3)}     &= \dfrac {1} {6}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{P(head)}      &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1 \times 3} {2 \times 3} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {3} {6}
\end{aligned}
$

Using the calculation above $\dfrac {3} {6} > \dfrac {1} {6}$.

So it is more likely to get a head with a fair coin than rolling a $3$ with an unbiased die with six faces.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\text {Getting a head with a fair coin}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tim has a box containing $9$ red, $6$ blue and $5$ yellow counters. He 
picks one counter at random without looking in the box. What 
is the probability that he will NOT select a red counter?

Give your answer as a fraction.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tim has a box containing $9$ red, $6$ blue and $5$ yellow counters. He 
picks one counter at random without looking in the box. What 
is the probability that he will NOT select a red counter?
<emptyline>
Give your answer as a fraction.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

**NOT** selecting a red counter is same as selecting a blue or yellow counter instead.

$
\begin{aligned} 
\text{P(Not a red counter)}      &= \dfrac {6 +  5} {6 + 5 + 9} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {11} {20}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {11} {20}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bag contains coloured counters of just **__two__** colours.  There are twenty green counters numbered $1$ to $20$ and thirty blue counters numbered $1$ to $30$. What is the probability of picking a counter from the bag which is a multiple of four?


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bag contains coloured counters of just **__two__** colours.  There are twenty green counters numbered $1$ to $20$ and thirty blue counters numbered $1$ to $30$. What is the probability of picking a counter from the bag which is a multiple of four?
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned} 
\text{Multiples of } 4 \text{ in green counter}    &= 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 \\\\
\text{Multiples of } 4 \text{ in blue counter}     &= 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28 \\\\
\text{P(Multiple of 4)}                             &= \dfrac {5 + 7} {50} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {12} {50} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 6} {2 \times 25} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 6} {\cancel{2} \times 25} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {6} {25}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {6} {25}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">- rtq_abbr_formula_katex_probability

<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned} 
\text{Multiples of } 4 \text{ in green counter}    &= 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 \\\\
\text{Multiples of } 4 \text{ in blue counter}     &= 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28 \\\\
\text{P(Multiple of 4)}                             &= \dfrac {5 + 7} {50} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {12} {50} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 6} {2 \times 25} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 6} {\cancel{2} \times 25} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {6} {25}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Alison has $6$ yellow discs, $5$ blue discs and $9$ red discs which she places in a bag. 
When she draws one disc out, what is the probability that the disc is **NOT** red?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alison has $6$ yellow discs, $5$ blue discs and $9$ red discs which she places in a bag. 
When she draws one disc out, what is the probability that the disc is **NOT** red?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Note: **NOT** selecting a red disc is same as selecting a blue or yellow disc instead.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{P(not red)}   &= \dfrac {6 + 5} {6 + 5 + 9} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {11} {20}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {11} {20}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The arrow is spun and it has an equal chance of stopping at any of the numbers. Is it

- More likely to land on a prime number than not a prime number?

- Just as likely to land on a prime number as not a prime number?

- More likely to land on a number that is not a prime number rather than a prime number?

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The arrow is spun and it has an equal chance of stopping at any of the numbers. Is it
<emptyline>
- More likely to land on a prime number than not a prime number?
<emptyline>
- Just as likely to land on a prime number as not a prime number?
<emptyline>
- More likely to land on a number that is not a prime number rather than a prime number?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{prime numbers}         &= 2, 7, 11, 13 \\\\
\text{P(prime number)}       &= \dfrac {4} {8} \\\\  
                             &= \dfrac {4} {2 \times 4} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {\cancel {4}} {2 \times \cancel {4}} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
\text{not a prime number}    &= 6, 9, 12, 4 \\\\                             
\text{P(not a prime number)} &= \dfrac {4} {8} \\\\ 
                             &= \dfrac {4} {2 \times 4} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {\cancel {4}} {2 \times \cancel {4}} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\                   
\end{aligned}
$

Just as likely to land on a prime number as not a prime number.

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Green counters} &= \text{Total counters} - \text{Red counters} - \text{Yellow counters} \\\\
                      &= 40 - \dfrac {1} {2} \times 40 - \dfrac {1} {5} \times 40 \\\\

                      &= 40 - \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 20} {\cancel{2}} - \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 8} {\cancel{5}} \\\\
                      &= 40 - 20 - 8 \\\\
                      &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the probability of rolling a **multiple of** $4$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the probability of rolling a **multiple of** $4$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{multiple of 4}           &= 4, 12, 16, 20, 24 \\\\
\text{P(multiple of 4)}       &= \dfrac {5} {6} \\\\                    
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {5} {6}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the probability of rolling a **square number**?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the probability of rolling a **square number**?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Probability}  = \dfrac { \text{ Favourable outcomes} } { \text{Total outcomes} }$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{square numbers}     &= 4, 16 \\\\
\text{P(square number)} &= \dfrac {2} {6} \\\\ 
                        &= \dfrac {2} {3 \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {2}} {3 \times \cancel {2}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {3}$

</div>
